name: Deployment Editor
description: A visual software packaging editor for creating Windows deployment packages using PSAppDeployToolkit (PSADT). Build automated PowerShell deployment scripts through a GUI with drag-and-drop sequences, project templates, and one-click script generation for SCCM, Intune, WinGet, or task sequences.
author: Tugay Taskin

securityCheck.aiSummary: The Deployment Editor includes legitimate Intune Graph integration and packaging workflows, but presents several security concerns: (1) remote code execution risk from dynamic Invoke-Expression usage to materialize adtSession data from PSADT files; (2) execution policy bypass via Set-ExecutionPolicy ByPass; (3) plaintext exposure risk for credentials during Graph authentication by converting SecureString to plaintext; (4) reliance on placeholder defaults that could indicate misconfiguration; (5) potential information disclosure from exporting internal PSADT command metadata locally. Mitigations include eliminating dynamic Evaluate-Expression on untrusted inputs, removing execution policy bypass, avoiding plaintext credential handling, validating non-default configuration values, and restricting metadata exposure.

noRemoteExecution.reason: Use of Invoke-Expression to evaluate the adtSession value derived from the PSADT deployment file. This dynamic evaluation can execute arbitrary code if the PSADT script is tampered or crafted.

noMaliciousPatterns.reason: Set-ExecutionPolicy ByPass -Scope CurrentUser. This overrides user policy and is a known technique to bypass restrictions, potentially abused by attackers.
